title: #33 pop-in opt-in (DRAFT, M6, 2026-11-25, NOT STAGED, no GO): row 1 identity (base vs off) and title-idle checks of the s33 nohunk5 bin; cold-attract rows run via harness\run-game.ps1, see TESTPLAN.md
notes: DRAFT by M6 (build/agent6/s33-popin/TESTPLAN.md). Nothing here is staged or GO'd; the Overseer / matrix owner copies it to bench/agent8/run/ only after the bin exists and LOAD GO. Arm ids are alphanumeric on purpose: w6_kit.py reads the arm from runs/HHMM-<arm>-rN with [A-Za-z0-9]+.

Bins: base = build/agent2/devoff4b-bin (S4b base, SDK 5350b1d, MANIFEST DE11A914079D7DF7). Patched = build/agent2/devoff4b-s33-bin (PROVISIONAL name; M2 builds it after LOAD GO from 5350b1d + build/agent6/s33-popin/s33-popin-nohunk5.patch, sha256 57CFA8ADF1E90079...). offd/ond need a bin with diagnostic (d) (s33-popin-nohunk5-diagd.patch, sha256 797E614284B64226..., UNRATED): devoff4b-s33d-bin if built as a second bin; if (d) goes into the first bin, set their bin to devoff4b-s33-bin. A missing bin skips its arms (runner rule).

This runner has no pad route, so these runs stay on the title / front end: they test row 1 (identity: the same code path with the cvar off, counters within noise, W/E/C 40/0/0, no d3d12_pipeline_creation_no_wait line), boot and title pipeline creation, and the gate WARNs (row 6). The pop-in scene points (first 3D frame ~launch+151 s, H0 ~launch+180 s, the 67-miss burst ~H0+21 s, the 12.4k shot) need harness\routes\attract-long.txt via harness\run-game.ps1 (TESTPLAN.md rows 1c, 2, 4, 5, (d)).
Every run is cold: run-timing.ps1 gives each run a fresh run dir and cache (no seed_cache here). Never copy cache/ or seeds between bin dirs.

Logdiff: build\agent6\s33-popin\RUN-S33-LOGDIFF.cmd <matrix folder> --ref off (row 1a: base vs off, both default cvars) and --ref offsf (onsf, gates). Expect rules: build/agent6/s33-popin/expect-s33.json. MORE/GONE slow-frame keys between onsf and offsf are the measurement, not a regression; basesf vs offsf differ by the appended slow-frame text (ONLY/GONE key, NOTE only).
Agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only; timing only from the user's unlocked desktop.
